O tema, a seleção de comparação e os fav: Your theme, comparison selection and favorites saved without an account are stored in this browser. When you sign in with Discord, favorites are stored in your account and can be accessed on other devices. We use only your basic identification, display name and avatar; we do not request messages, email or a list of servers. Your profile starts private. You can publish a name, handle, bio, cover, avatar, Roblox username and website. The Roblox username is provided by the player and does not verify account ownership. Favorites are public only if you choose to show them. With a public profile, you can post messages and photos, comment and add friends through requests and acceptance. Posts and comments are public. You can edit or delete your own content. Making your profile private hides your posts from public view. Correction suggestions and reports are reviewed by the wiki administrator. Deleting your data removes your profile, posts and their comments, friendships, images, synced favorites, sessions and the text of your article comments. Other people’s replies in wiki articles are preserved.
